arguments.message: I’m sorry to hear this happened. Please go to **Settings → Developer → Webhooks** and either disable the webhook or repoint it to a safe endpoint – this stops any further deliveries right away. Then, report the incident to our support team so we can investigate when the endpoint was changed, which account made the change, and what data may have been delivered to the unauthorized domain.
